chapters.screen: Neural Network (MLP). A small neural network bends its boundary by tuning 113 weights together. Watch real training: after every mini-batch of 32 passengers, Adam nudges every weight to lower the log loss, and the maps take shape.
chapters.spoken: Neural Network (M-L-P). A small neural network bends its boundary by tuning 113 weights together. Watch real training: after every mini-batch of 32 passengers, Adam nudges every weight to lower the log loss, and the maps take shape.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: Random starting weights after one mini-batch: the maps barely separate anyone. Validation accuracy 37%.
chapters.spoken: Random starting weights after one mini-batch: the maps barely separate anyone. Validation accuracy 37%.

chapters.screen: Each frame is real training: the first epoch in quarters, then one frame per epoch. Edge colour is the weight's sign; thickness is its size.
chapters.spoken: Each frame is real training: the first epoch in quarters, then one frame per epoch. Edge colour is the weight's sign; thickness is its size.

chapters.screen: 40 epochs: train accuracy 78%, validation 77%. ReLU units switch on at different ages and fares, so the boundary bends.
chapters.spoken: 40 epochs: train accuracy 78%, validation 77%. ReLU units switch on at different ages and fares, so the boundary bends.

chapters.screen: A forward pass for the unseen passenger: for these inputs no first-layer unit fires (every ReLU outputs 0), so only the later biases reach the sigmoid output.
chapters.spoken: A forward pass for the unseen passenger: for these inputs no first-layer unit fires (every ReLU outputs 0), so only the later biases reach the sigmoid output.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: The network's ReLU units crease its score and the output squashes it into a probability: smooth slopes with folds. Height is the model's P(survive), one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: The network's ReLU units crease its score and the output squashes it into a probability: smooth slopes with folds. Height is the model's chance of survival, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 83% with every input against 82% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 83% with every input against 82% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: A neural network is many simple units tuned together by gradient descent; together they can bend into almost any boundary. Limitation: with 627 training passengers it can easily over-fit, it needs scaled inputs and careful tuning, and its weights are hard to interpret.
chapters.spoken: A neural network is many simple units tuned together by gradient descent; together they can bend into almost any boundary. Limitation: with 627 training passengers it can easily over-fit, it needs scaled inputs and careful tuning, and its weights are hard to interpret.
